checks.expr: (function(){ const s = window.__3D_STATE__; if (!s) return false; const keys = Object.keys(s); if (!keys.length) return !!(document.querySelector('canvas')); const kws = ["abalone","iridescen","multi","asset"]; return keys.some(k => kws.some(w => k.toLowerCase().includes(w))); })()

transitions.description: The IridescenceAbalone model is loaded and present in the scene

checks.expr: (function(){ const s = window.__3D_STATE__; if (!s) return false; const keys = Object.keys(s); if (!keys.length) return !!(document.querySelector('canvas')); const kws = ["plant","multi","asset","postprocess"]; return keys.some(k => kws.some(w => k.toLowerCase().includes(w))); })()

transitions.description: The DiffuseTransmissionPlant model is loaded and visible with translucent/transmission material

checks.expr: (function(){ const s = window.__3D_STATE__; if (!s) return false; for (const k of Object.keys(s)) { const v = s[k]; if (Array.isArray(v) && v.length >= 4) return true; if (typeof v === 'number' && v >= 4) return true; } return false; })()

transitions.description: An EffectComposer or post-processing pipeline is initialized with at least 4 passes/effects
Bloom effect is active and its intensity/strength can be adjusted via the control panel UI
Chromatic aberration effect is present and modifies the rendered output
Depth of field (bokeh) effect is configured and responds to focus distance changes
Vignette effect is applied, darkening the edges of the rendered frame
Film grain / noise effect is present and its intensity is adjustable
The scene renders with a visible bioluminescent color palette — dominant blues, teals, or cyans in the final composited output

_conversion_note: Converted from legacy checks[] format. check.script references to window.scene/window.__scene replaced with window.__3D_STATE__.__scene. Models must expose scene object via window.__3D_STATE__.__scene = scene.
_patch_note: behavioral-contract check expression rewritten from legacy checks[] using semantic rules. State fields not yet precisely constrained. Pending step3 standardization.
